We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account referenced above. We understand that you have disputed the debt as inaccurate and requested its removal from your credit report. We will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the debt. If our investigation confirms that the debt is valid, we will provide you with a validation notice as required by the FDCPA. If our investigation confirms that the debt is inaccurate, we will take steps to correct the error and remove the debt from your credit report.

Please be advised that under the FDCPA, you have the right to dispute the debt and request that we verify its accuracy. You also have the right to request that we provide you with a written validation notice, which we will do if our investigation confirms that the debt is valid.

We will investigate this matter further and respond to your dispute in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.
